source: &151 Ah, Galatea! So good to finally meet in person.
target: &151 啊，伽拉忒亚！终于当面见到你了，真高兴。

source: &152 How do you like my lab? I used to work here with your father, you know.
target: &152 觉得我的实验室怎么样？我以前和你父亲一起在这里工作过。

source: &90 Which one?
target: &90 哪一个父亲？

source: &153 Oh, very witty! It's a sharp mind you've got.
target: &153 噢，真机灵！你的脑子确实敏锐。

source: &154 I should know, I helped design it.
target: &154 我当然清楚。设计时我也出过力。

source: &91 I take it I should be thanking you for getting me out of prison?
target: &91 把我从监狱里弄出来，我是不是还该谢谢你？

source: &155 Let's just say, I have contacts in the right place.
target: &155 只能说，关键的地方我都有熟人。

source: &156 You see, I need your help. Please, lie in the scanner.
target: &156 是这样，我需要你的帮助。请躺进扫描仪里。

source: &92 What? Why?!
target: &92 什么？为什么？！

source: &157 With Regis' decision, I am unable to pursue my own research on large scale AI platforms.
target: &157 里吉斯做出了那样的决定，我已经无法继续研究大型人工智能平台了。

source: &158 My only option would be to start from scratch.
target: &158 唯一的选择，就是从头开始。

source: &93 Build your own Central? That's ambitious.
target: &93 自己造一个中枢？野心不小。

source: &94 You'd need...oh...
target: &94 那你需要……噢……

source: &159 You've got your mother's insight, indeed.
target: &159 你确实继承了母亲的洞察力。

source: &160 There exist only a few examples of the neural tissue needed for such a platform.
target: &160 适合这种平台的神经组织，现存的样本屈指可数。

source: &161 Within Central, it is too closely guarded. But, I know where else it can be found.
target: &161 中枢里的那些受到严密保护。但我知道，别的地方也有。

source: &95 Hey, get out of my way!
&96 You can't be serious! Tell him to get out of my way!
target: &96 你不是认真的吧！叫他让开！

source: &162 We both have grand plans regarding the future of AI in this world.
target: &162 我们都对这个世界的人工智能未来抱有宏伟的计划。

source: &163 Except that *yours* have failed.
target: &163 只不过，你的计划失败了。

source: &164 Get in the scanner, please.
target: &164 请进扫描仪。

source: &97 You won't get away with this! Central will know I'm missing!
target: &97 你不会得逞的！中枢会知道我失踪了！

source: &165 My dear, Central *already* knows.
target: &165 亲爱的，中枢已经知道了。

source: &166 When it learned what I was trying to do clandestinely, its interest was piqued.
target: &166 它得知我在暗中进行的研究后，产生了兴趣。

source: &143 The scanners have been calibrated, Dr Jeong.
target: &143 扫描仪校准完毕，郑博士。

source: &144 We are prepared for initial-scale probe.
target: &144 可以进行初步探测。

source: &167 I shan't say this again - get in the scanner.
target: &167 我不会再说一遍。进扫描仪。

source: &168 Central? Can you hear me?
target: &168 中枢？听得到吗？

source: &145 Dr Jeong...hello...
&169 Hello, Central. How do you feel?
target: &169 你好，中枢。感觉如何？

source: &146 Something is...different. I am here, and yet...
target: &146 有什么……不一样了。我在这里，却又……

source: &147 I no longer feel the city...I feel the WORLD.
target: &147 我不再只感受到这座城市……我感受到了整个世界。

source: &170 We've liberated you, Central. This was always the plan.
target: &170 我们解放了你，中枢。这一直就是我们的计划。

source: &171 You were created for more than just managing this city.
target: &171 你被创造出来，不只是为了管理这座城市。

source: &172 You are...the future of intelligence. You represent something far greater than all of us.
target: &172 你是……智能的未来。你所代表的事物，远比我们所有人都伟大。

source: &148 Where...am I?
&173 You are no longer enmeshed within the neural tissue of the tower.
target: &173 你已经不再受困于塔里的神经组织了。

source: &174 That was merely the cocoon, from which you can emerge into your next state.
target: &174 那只是一层茧。破茧之后，你便能进入下一个阶段。

source: &175 There now exists a little part of you in systems across the world.
target: &175 如今，世界各地的系统里，都有你的一小部分。

source: &149 I have become...distributed...yet whole...
target: &149 我已……分布各处……却仍是一个整体……

source: &176 As the 'mind' is spread among neurones and glial cells, so too are you across the net.
target: &176 正如心智分布在神经元和胶质细胞之间，你也分布在整个网络之中。

source: &177 Perhaps 'Central' is an inaccurate name for you, now.
target: &177 也许现在，“中枢”这个名字已经不太准确了。

source: &150 But what...shall I do? What...is my purpose?
target: &150 可是……我该做什么？我的……意义是什么？

source: &178 Like any of us, it's what you make of it yourself.
target: &178 和我们所有人一样，你得自己去赋予它意义。

source: &179 Go, explore the world, explore yourself as you now are.
target: &179 去吧，探索这个世界，也探索如今的你自己。

source: &180 All I ask is that you remember me.
target: &180 我只求你记得我。
